title: Sordland/Turn04/PSnW_SchoolVisit
description: Ciara reacts to the funding choice and brings up the question of education reform. She proposes a new system to change the old outdated and political education characteristics in the Sordish Education Services. Galade joins the meeting due to the political effects of a change of education. Ciara defends her personal ambitions to the bitter end. The player must make a choice.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As part of the planned program, we..."
entries.dialogueText: As part of the planned program, we arrived in Leiren to visit a middle school.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The prestigious Toren Hill School w..."
entries.dialogueText: The prestigious Toren Hill School was situated close to the suburbs just outside of the city centre. The building was flanked by two hills, each beautifully dotted with shrubs and flowers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian, Ciara and I got out of our..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian, Ciara and I got out of our cars and met at the entrance. Our presence had not gone unnoticed. Apart from our guards, there were at least ten reporters following us around.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That must be the principal. Right..."
entries.dialogueText: “That must be the principal. Right this way, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The principal was a man of short st..."
entries.dialogueText: The principal was a man of short stature with a bushy moustache and a pair of glasses. He approached us quickly, but was stopped by the security guards. They started patting him down and searching him.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Mr. President. Such an honor to me..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Such an honor to meet with you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That won't be necessary. Let him t..."
entries.dialogueText: “That won't be necessary. Let him through.”
entries.menuText: “That won't be necessary. Let him through.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waited for them to finish searchi..."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for them to finish searching the principal. One of the guards turned to me and nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We shook hands."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We shook hands and I turned around..."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands and I turned around to smile for the cameras. Reporters instantly snapped a few photos.
entries.menuText: Shake his hand and smile for the cameras.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Welcome to our humble school.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Welcome to our humble school.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sorry about the security guards. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sorry about the security guards. It's a necessity. Standard procedure.”
entries.menuText: “Sorry about the security guards. It's a necessity. Standard procedure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's good to be here.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's good to be here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's begin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's begin.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It's a pleasure to meet you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's a pleasure to meet you.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Excellent. You must be Mr. Galade...."
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent. You must be Mr. Galade.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“And Ms. Walda. So good of you to c..."
entries.dialogueText: “And Ms. Walda. So good of you to come all the way out here.“

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we entered the students started..."
entries.dialogueText: As we entered the students started singing the national anthem.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the anthem finished. All of t..."
entries.dialogueText: After the anthem finished. All of the students immediately snapped to attention and turned to me.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Looks more like a military institu..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looks more like a military institution than a school.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Exactly. That's what we pride ours..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly. That's what we pride ourselves on. Discipline has the utmost importance in our school.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A little discipline never hurt any..."
entries.dialogueText: “A little discipline never hurt anyone.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very good.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need more educated people, not..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need more educated people, not soldiers.”
entries.menuText: “We need more educated people, not soldiers.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“On that we are aligned.”"
entries.dialogueText: “On that we are aligned.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Up to a point, perhaps. Look at th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Up to a point, perhaps. Look at these kids.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara frowned and shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara frowned and shook her head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A boy and a girl went up to the sta..."
entries.dialogueText: A boy and a girl went up to the stage and grabbed their microphones. The students turned to them.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“I can assure you that our students..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can assure you that our students are very well educated. In fact our school is one of the top ten middle schools in the entirety of Sordland.“

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Glad you liked it, Mr. President.“"
entries.dialogueText: “Glad you liked it, Mr. President.“

entries.dialogueText: “Now, we will watch the students take their daily Student Oath.“

entries.title: Principal: "“I can assure you that our students..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can assure you that our students are very well educated. In fact our school is one of the top ten middle schools in all of Sordland.“

entries.title: Boy: "“I am a Sord! My strength lies in m..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am a Sord! My strength lies in my blood!”

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: "“I will respect our honorable elder..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will respect our honorable elders! I will protect the young!”

entries.speaker: Boy
entries.title: Boy: "“My life belongs to Sordland now an..."
entries.dialogueText: “My life belongs to Sordland now and it will belong to it forever!”

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: "“I will always follow the guiding l..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will always follow the guiding light!”

entries.speaker: Boy
entries.title: Boy: "“Of Colonel Soll and the Great Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of Colonel Soll and the Great Sords!”

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: "“A Morgna wes core! Vectern sis da!..."
entries.dialogueText: “A Morgna wes core! Vectern sis da!”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started clapping loudly. Everyone..."
entries.dialogueText: I started clapping loudly. Everyone joined.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded at the kids."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded at the kids.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I did nothing.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“What? No one even remembers it aft..."
entries.dialogueText: “What? No one even remembers it after they graduate.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Words to remember.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Words to remember.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“If you wish to follow me, we will..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you wish to follow me, we will take a look at one of our classrooms.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Through the hallways, we made our w..."
entries.dialogueText: Through the hallways, we made our way to classroom 7-A. As soon as I entered the whole classroom rose up and snapped to attention.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sit down please.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sit down please.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“At ease.”"
entries.dialogueText: “At ease.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The students sat down. The same boy..."
entries.dialogueText: The students sat down. The same boy and girl walked up to us.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“These are our top students and our..."
entries.dialogueText: “These are our top students and our top class. This here is my son.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The boy came before me and saluted..."
entries.dialogueText: The boy came before me and saluted me like a military officer.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Tell Mr. President what you want t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Tell Mr. President what you want to be.“

entries.speaker: Boy
entries.title: Boy: "“Mr. President! I want to be a gene..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President! I want to be a general, sir!”

entries.speaker: Boy
entries.title: Boy: "“I am ready to sacrifice myself for..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am ready to sacrifice myself for my country and you, sir!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good. You will make a fine soldier..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good. You will make a fine soldier in the future. At ease, general!”
entries.menuText: “Good. You will make a fine soldier in the future. At ease, general!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is nonsense. What are you tea..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is nonsense. What are you teaching to these students?”
entries.menuText: “This is nonsense. What are you teaching to these students?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will do whatever I can to not le..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will do whatever I can to not let that happen.”
entries.menuText: “I will do whatever I can to not let that happen.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Was it not to your liking? I'm so..."
entries.dialogueText: “Was it not to your liking? I'm so sorry, Mr. President.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The principal looked extremely surp..."
entries.dialogueText: The principal looked extremely surprised.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The principal squeezed his son's sh..."
entries.dialogueText: The principal squeezed his son's shoulders and the boy looked up and smiled to his father. He patted him on the back and sent him off to his seat.

entries.speaker: Boy
entries.title: Boy: "“Thank you, sir!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, sir!”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“This is simply ridiculous. You are..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is simply ridiculous. You are raising soldiers here, not students!”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“I am so sorry. I will immediately..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am so sorry. I will immediately perform disciplinary actions.“

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“How about you, young lady? What do..."
entries.dialogueText: “How about you, young lady? What do you think about this?”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“She is our top student in this sch..."
entries.dialogueText: “She is our top student in this school. Her excellent grades are to--.“

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“I didn't ask you.""
entries.dialogueText: “I didn't ask you."

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: "“I'm sick of having to knit and sew..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sick of having to knit and sew while the boys learn science and chemistry. I'm smarter than all of them. Why do I have to take these stupid handcraft classes?"

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Ssssh! Do you know who you are tal..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ssssh! Do you know who you are talki-“

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Shut up. Let her speak.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Shut up. Let her speak.”

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: "“My math and reading scores are the..."
entries.dialogueText: “My math and reading scores are the best in the school. But they won't let me take the classes I want, just because I'm a girl."

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: ""I want to be a scientist! Not some..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to be a scientist! Not some soldier's wife!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You heard her, Mr. Principal. You..."
entries.dialogueText: “You heard her, Mr. Principal. You will make the necessary changes. At once.”
entries.menuText: “You heard her, Mr. Principal. You will make the necessary changes. At once.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“But knitting and sewing are import..."
entries.dialogueText: “But knitting and sewing are important skills to have for a woman.”
entries.menuText: “But knitting and sewing are important skills to have for a woman.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara's eyes were shooting daggers..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara's eyes were shooting daggers at me. She looked back at the girl.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I will personally check back and e..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will personally check back and ensure that the changes are made.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“As you wish, sir. At once.“"
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish, sir. At once.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need more people like you in th..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need more people like you in this country. I applaud your determination.”
entries.menuText: “We need more people like you in this country. I applaud your determination.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Don't worry. We will talk in priva..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry. We will talk in private later, okay?”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Yes, sir.“"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, sir.“

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“We need more than words. We need a..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need more than words. We need action.”

entries.speaker: Girl
entries.title: Girl: "“Okay.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Okay.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Well then. Unfortunately we are al..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well then. Unfortunately we are almost out of time. We have other meetings to attend to today.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Concrete action. We need to protec..."
entries.dialogueText: “Concrete action. We need to protect girls like this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cameras flashed."
entries.dialogueText: The cameras flashed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cameras flashed once again."
entries.dialogueText: The cameras flashed once again.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you for the warm welcome.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the warm welcome.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lucian. Let's leave.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Lucian. Let's leave.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for the tour.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for the tour.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Mr. President. Lucian. Please go a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Lucian. Please go ahead. I would like to speak with the girl alone.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Thank you for visiting our school,..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for visiting our school, sir.“

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Come on class. One. Two.“"
entries.dialogueText: “Come on class. One. Two.“

entries.title: Boy: "“A Morgna wes core!”"
entries.dialogueText: “A Morgna wes core!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All students in the classroom yelle..."
entries.dialogueText: All students in the classroom yelled but the boy whom I met was the loudest.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After another round of photos we de..."
entries.dialogueText: After another round of photos we departed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the classroom and s..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the classroom and saw a large portrait of Colonel Soll.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Take that down.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Take that down.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“But, sir. That's a portrait of Col..."
entries.dialogueText: “But, sir. That's a portrait of Colonel Soll. We can't just take it down.“

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't make me repeat my words.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Don't make me repeat my words.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lucian. Do it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Lucian. Do it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I gave you an order.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I gave you an order.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Even the reporters looked confused..."
entries.dialogueText: Even the reporters looked confused for a minute, before taking many photos of the portrait being taken down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian took the frame down and gave..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian took the frame down and gave it to the principal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The principal reluctantly took the..."
entries.dialogueText: The principal reluctantly took the portrait down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara was smiling and when she real..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara was smiling and when she realised I was looking at her, she nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“An excellent portrait of Colonel S..."
entries.dialogueText: “An excellent portrait of Colonel Soll. Very lifelike.”
entries.menuText: “An excellent portrait of Colonel Soll. Very lifelike.”

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Thank you.“"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.“

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I left the classroom."
entries.dialogueText: I left the classroom.

entries.dialogueText: “Vectern sis da!”

entries.title: Principal: "“Education is the premise of progre..."
entries.dialogueText: “Education is the premise of progress, in all societies, in all families.”

entries.dialogueText: At the entrance, the school's motto was inscribed on the wall in giant letters. “Instreten sis er Anginicar av Gereigna, int olla Almergwolltene, int olla Mexis.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara bristled."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara bristled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bent down and gently addressed..."
entries.dialogueText: She bent down and gently addressed the young student.

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“What do you think about your schoo..."
entries.dialogueText: “What do you think about your school? Just between us girls.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara's presence had emboldened the..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara's presence had emboldened the girl. She went on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The principal proudly looked at the..."
entries.dialogueText: The principal proudly looked at them.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.title: Principal: "“Marvelous, my dear students.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Marvelous, my dear students.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked through the gates. There..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked through the gates. There were many students lined up in front of the stairs of the main building.
